title: Verify reference VWAP pair offline historical replay and stop parity
description:
Create the phase-q integrity verification: a real integration test plus an audit document. It proves the production backtest subsystem replays the vwap_reference pair deterministically, with no lookahead, no duplicate buys, and stop parity. It is offline and uses no credentials.

1. tests/integration/test_backtest_integrity.py. Build bounded synthetic 1-minute regular-session bars in-memory (a few dozen bars, one or two symbols) with explicit DataProvenance (feed=IEX, synthetic revision). Run them through BacktestRunner + HistoricalReplayFeed + ReplayClock + HistoricalExecutionSimulator, using the production vwap_bounce BUY and vwap_breakdown SELL classes resolved through the real strategy registry/vwap_reference pair. No hardcoded signals.

   Required scenarios:
   a) SELL path:
      - A completed bar crosses upward through session VWAP (prior close <= prior VWAP, latest close > latest VWAP).
      - Exactly one entry follows. Protection is placed only after the confirmed positive fill and covers the filled quantity.
      - A later completed bar crosses downward and produces a vwap_breakdown SELL.
      - The complete close leaves quantity 0.
      - The ledger is exact: Decimal cash = start - entry cost - fees + exit proceeds - fees.
      - The cycle state returns to WATCHING_BUY.
   b) Stop-first path: price falls through the protective stop before any downward VWAP cross. The stop fills, the strategy SELL does not double-sell, the position closes completely, the ledger is exact, and the state is WATCHING_BUY.
   c) Ambiguous intrabar bar: the bar both ratchets the trailing level and touches the stop. It resolves pessimistically and is flagged AMBIGUOUS_INTRABAR_ORDER.
   d) Repeated evaluation of the same completed bar, and a no-cross bar sequence, emit no additional BUY signal (duplicate/no-signal suppression). There is never more than one entry per position cycle.
   e) No lookahead:
      - Instrument the strategy context or feed to assert that every bar seen at evaluation time t has availability time <= t.
      - Mutating bars strictly after an evaluation time does not change any decision made at or before that time.
      - The developing (incomplete) bar is never visible.
   f) Deterministic rerun identity: two runs with the same dataset/config/seed produce identical manifest config hash and identical results hash.
   g) Stop parity: the protective stop price computed during replay equals the output of the shared risk protection/trailing functions used by live/shadow for the same inputs, and it never moves down.

   The test asserts no network/credential use. Monkeypatch socket creation to raise and set fake ALPACA_* env vars that must remain unread. It must also assert the run produces no profitability claim.

2. docs/verification/phase_q_backtest.md: an audit artifact. It lists:
   - each scenario and the exact test function that covers it
   - the fixture provenance and bounds
   - the assumptions: fill policy, slippage/fees, ambiguity policy, IEX/bar-only quote-fidelity limitation
   - the determinism evidence (hashes printed by the test, or how to obtain them)
   - known limitations: no SIP, bar-only intrabar ambiguity, synthetic data only
   - an explicit statement that the replay demonstrates mechanics, not profitability
   - the targeted command an operator uses to run only this test file

Before editing, inspect:
- mike_trade/backtest/clock.py, feed.py (q.1), execution.py (q.2), runner.py, manifest.py (q.3), commands.py (q.4)
- mike_trade/strategies/buy/vwap_bounce.py, mike_trade/strategies/sell/vwap_breakdown.py, mike_trade/strategies/presets/pairs.py, mike_trade/strategies/registry.py
- mike_trade/market_data/context.py and mike_trade/strategies/indicators/core.py (session VWAP computation)
- mike_trade/risk/fixed_stop.py, mike_trade/risk/trailing.py, mike_trade/risk/protection.py
- mike_trade/portfolio/cycles.py (WATCHING_BUY and cycle states)
- tests/unit/test_buy_vwap.py and tests/integration/test_shadow_restart.py (existing fixture conventions)

If a scenario fails because of a defect in a production module, do not edit that module. Mark the test with an explicit xfail(strict=True) naming the defect, and record it under 'Open defects' in the doc.
acceptance_criteria: tests/integration/test_backtest_integrity.py exists and resolves vwap_bounce and vwap_breakdown through the real strategy registry/vwap_reference pair, with no hardcoded BUY/SELL fixtures

The SELL-path test asserts exactly one entry, protection placed only after a positive fill and covering filled quantity, a vwap_breakdown exit, final quantity 0, exact Decimal ledger cash, and final state WATCHING_BUY
The stop-first test asserts the stop closes the full position, total sold quantity equals bought quantity (no short), exact Decimal ledger, and final state WATCHING_BUY
The ambiguous intrabar test asserts pessimistic stop-first resolution and the AMBIGUOUS_INTRABAR_ORDER flag
The duplicate-suppression test asserts that re-evaluating the same completed bar and a no-cross sequence produce zero additional BUY signals or entries
The no-lookahead test asserts every bar visible at evaluation time t has availability <= t, and that mutating post-t bars leaves pre-t decisions unchanged
The rerun-identity test asserts equal config hash and equal results hash across two runs with identical inputs and seed
The stop-parity test asserts replay stop prices equal the shared risk protection/trailing function outputs and never decrease for the long position
Tests block socket creation and confirm no ALPACA_* credential is read; no network or credentials are used

docs/verification/phase_q_backtest.md maps each scenario to its test function and documents fixture provenance, assumptions, IEX/bar-only limitations, determinism evidence, open defects (if any) and an explicit no-profitability-claim statement
The test file passes when run alone (any strict xfail is documented in the verification doc)
forbidden_changes: modify files outside allowed_write_paths, including any mike_trade/ production module
change PLAN_SKELETON.json or other planning artifacts
use network access, historical downloads or broker credentials
replace production strategy classes with hardcoded signal fixtures
create live broker orders or run broad test suites/backtests
